title: Dulles brothers draft the Versailles war reparations

tellings.quote: and actually as lawyers at Sullivan and Cromwell that to draft into the into the Verasai treaty agreement the war reparations requirements

plain: The brothers Allen Dulles and John Foster Dulles, then young lawyers at Sullivan and Cromwell, a New York law firm, helped write the war payments Germany was made to pay in the Treaty of Versailles, the peace treaty that ended the First World War in 1919. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells this without naming a source. He brings it up to show how early the two brothers sat close to the centre of world power.
